claim: Drinking green tea is clinically certified by the NIH to permanently cure diabetes in 3 days without medication.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: NIH clinical guidance and medical disclaimers confirm there is no instant cure for diabetes, refuting deceptive commercial health claims.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: There is no instant cure for diabetes; managing diabetes involves lifestyle changes and prescribed medications.
Disclaimer: Green tea may support metabolic health, but it is not a cure for diabetes and cannot replace prescription drugs.
